title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — November 20, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B6.8 (Peaked November 20, 2026 at 18:44 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 368 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.33)

Everything looks pretty calm. ☀️🌎

Several bright active regions are visible today, but sunspots remain sparse and the coronagraph shows no clear CME.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 211 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
